settings.observation_policy: Identical A-D: Sapiens body/shoulders/wrists plus per-hand WiLoR 21 2D points. Fingers fixed. No predicted WiLoR 3D or triangulated loss. Views averaged; groups independently normalized.
settings.selection: Primary E weight 0.001 and cam3 initialization fixed before fitting. All strengths and alternate initialization reported; no GT-based selection.
settings.purpose: Only allow 10 shared shape coefficients and add their soft zero-centered prior to B. Other losses, constraints, input points, initialization and steps unchanged.
settings.shape_prior: weight * mean(betas ** 2), centered at zero model shape; isotropic regularizer, not device-calibrated population covariance

gt_inputs: Head pose and cameras only; no GT shape/body pose/keypoints/silhouette
